description: Dante Pittman is a proud homegrown product of Wilson County. He comes from a family of generations of Wilsonians. After graduating from Wilson County Public Schools, he went to college at UNC-Chapel Hill. Dante served with the City of Wilson as Assistant to the City Manager and Human Relations Director. He currently serves as a Captain in the North Carolina Army National Guard.
